name: Agamand Heirlooms
summary: At Agamand Mills, Coleman Farthing seeks the family's heirlooms from their crypt. He blames the Agamands for his death and wants their ancestral weapons taken from them.

sections.title: A Servant's Bitter Grudge
sections.body: Coleman Farthing served the wealthy Agamand family at their mills in Tirisfal Glades before the Third War devastated Lordaeron. Whatever happened as the estate fell, Farthing blames his former lords for his death. Raised into undeath among the Forsaken, he takes spiteful satisfaction in the Agamands' downfall. The once-proud family has become mindless minions enslaved to the Lich King.

sections.title: Desecrating the Crypt
sections.body: Farthing sends you into the Agamand Family Crypt beneath the northern bluffs of the mills. Restless dead and lingering Scourge wander its stone halls. He wants you to take four relics: the Agamand family sword, axe, dagger, and mace. Their loss would strip the bloodline of its remaining honor.

faq.q: Who was Coleman Farthing in life?
faq.answer: Coleman Farthing served the wealthy Agamand family at Agamand Mills before the Scourge invasion of Lordaeron. He died during the calamity and blames his former masters, carrying that resentment into undeath.

faq.q: Why does Coleman Farthing want the heirlooms?
faq.answer: Farthing wants vengeance on his former masters. He seeks their ancestral sword, axe, dagger, and mace to strip the fallen family of its last honor and memory.

faq.q: What happened to the Agamand family?
faq.answer: The Agamand family perished when the Scourge swept across Tirisfal Glades. They were raised as mindless undead thralls bound to the Lich King, wandering their ruined mills and crypt.

faq.q: Where is the Agamand Family Crypt located?
faq.answer: The Agamand Family Crypt lies at the northern edge of Agamand Mills, in rocky cliffs overlooking the blighted farmsteads of northern Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: What weapons are kept within the crypt?
faq.answer: The crypt holds four ancestral weapons: the Agamand Family Sword, the Agamand Family Axe, the Agamand Family Dagger, and the Agamand Family Mace.

faq.q: Why are the Forsaken attacking the Agamands if both are undead?
faq.answer: The Forsaken have free will and fight for their own survival. The undead Agamands remain mindless Scourge slaves, serving the Lich King whom the Forsaken despise.

angles.text: As an Undead, you know how grudges from mortal life can linger after death among the Forsaken.
As Horde, you help weaken the Scourge's hold over northern Tirisfal Glades and make the realm safer for travelers.
As a Rogue, you know how to slip past lurking ghouls and take ancient weapons from guarded burial vaults.
